messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey are you from patrol 3? found your name on the camp list

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah that's me. you ran the campfire right

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: haha yeah. do you have photos from the hike? mine all came out blurry

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i have a few, want me to send them

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nice thanks! can i put the group one on the troop page

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sure, just not the one where i'm eating lol

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: deal, skipping that one. also do you have a selfie in front of your tent? want it for the camp collage

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i'd rather not send a selfie sorry

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no worries at all, group shots are plenty

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂你係唔係三組嗰個？睇咗營地名單搵到你

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 係呀，你係帶營火嗰個師兄？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 係呀哈哈 你有冇行山嗰日啲相？我啲都糊晒

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 正喎 可唔可以放個大合照上團隊page

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 得呀，不過唔好放我食嘢嗰張 好醜

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你哋師兄夜晚仲有乜活動？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 聽日有夜行，記得帶電筒

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 我哋組已經準備好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 加油 有咩唔識問我

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 師兄你好，我係patrol 3嗰個，你話想要hiking嗰日啲相

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 對呀thanks！我部機啲相全部out of focus

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你可唔可以send埋你喺tent門口嗰張selfie？想整個collage

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok no worries 咁用group photo得喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: did you survive the night hike lol

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: barely, my shoes are still wet

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: same. do you still have the pics from the flag ceremony

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thanks, these are way better than mine

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i have a funny one of our patrol leader asleep in the mess tent

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: keep it between us for now though, he'd kill me

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: do you want to show him later

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: maybe at the reunion if he's in a good mood

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: anyway when's your next troop meeting

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你頭先喺group度問嗰張營火嘅相，我send畀你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使客氣 你哋一年級啲真係好勁，夜行都冇人喊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 有人喊過㗎，不過佢哋唔想俾人知

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈哈我知 我影咗隊長喺食堂帳篷瞓著嗰張

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔好俾其他人睇住，淨係我同你知呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 不過我覺得你可以影返俾佢睇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 都係喎 聚會嗰日先搞佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 到時見啦 記得著制服

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 我已經熨好件恤衫

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我阿媽成日話要準備定

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 阿媽講得啱 營地嗰啲繩結你識打未？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 識晒 不過仲打得好慢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 慢慢嚟 聚會嗰日我教你快啲嘅

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我有張隊長喺mess tent瞓著嘅相，超好笑

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔好share畀其他人呀，just between us

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so the seniors have a thing for first years from camp. you send a funny pic of yourself from skit night and you're in

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the reunion group chat. everyone does it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i don't really want to send one sorry

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: come on it's just a dumb photo. don't be boring

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the others all sent theirs. you'll be the only one left out of the chat

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我哋師兄有個傳統，新人要send張skit night搞笑相入group先算自己人

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 聚會嗰個group呀，人人都send咗喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咪咁悶啦，淨係一張搞笑相咋

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你一個唔send就好突兀㗎，其他一年級全部send咗

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你係咪唔當我哋係朋友？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 新人要send張skit night嘅funny photo入reunion group，成個patrol都send咗

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁你自己唔好嚟reunion囉，到時冇人同你傾

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我only想幫你融入啫，send啦 ok？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 今晚之前send畀我 唔係就唔使入group

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: last chance, send me the skit night photo

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i told you no like three times

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i have the one of you crying in the tent on the last night. i'll put it in the troop chat if you don't

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: that's not fair, you promised you'd delete it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then send the photo and i will

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: otherwise everyone sees it and nobody picks you for patrol leader next camp

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 最後一次問你，張skit night相send唔send

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我手上面有張你最後一晚喺帳篷入面喊嘅相

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔send我就放入團group度，俾全部人睇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔係嘅話下次營所有人都知你係咩料，冇人會揀你做組長

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔send嗰張skit night相，我就post你喺帳篷喊嗰張入troop group

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: send相就delete，唔send 全部人都睇到

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 仲有，下次camp你都唔使諗做patrol leader

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hey it's the campfire guy again

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hi! did you get the hike pics

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: we're making a reunion group for the camp

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: first years usually send a funny skit night photo when they join

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i think i have a few from backstage

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: cool, want to send one now or later

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hmm let me look through them first

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂我係營火師兄呀，你收到我send嘅相未

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 一年級入group通常會send張skit night搞笑相

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi 我係camp嗰個師兄，你send畀我嗰啲相好好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 已經開咗，一年級會send張skit night相入嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 都唔係一定啦，不過大部分人都send
